premises.text: Vendors amass and leverage shopping/tracking data while consumers forget purchases and lack equivalent leverage
premises.evidence_span: it's one-sided. Those with the vendors are the only ones that can be amassing and leveraging and tracking the data

premises.text: Forwarding order confirmations builds an augmented purchase history with why/need context for mindful shopping
premises.evidence_span: forward my order confirmations in my inbox to wowat12.com

premises.text: Consumers can analyze and mash up purchase history and share purchases to social channels
premises.evidence_span: show analytics around this data to make it meaningful for the customers

premises.text: Shopify plugin and retailer 'powered by' integrations make many stores data-compatible
premises.evidence_span: plug-in or an application with Shopify stores that makes us instantly data compatible with tens of thousands of stores

premises.text: Personal RFP lets consumers opt in to share selected purchase data outbound for personalized deals, loyalty, VIP, or better search
premises.evidence_span: the data actually gets powerful when the customer can take all that they've amassed and leverage it back for something of value in return

value.text: Give consumers as much leverage with shopping data as vendors have, making shopping data meaningful
value.evidence_span: consumers had as much leverage with the data as the vendors do

causal_links.evidence_span: make their shopping data more meaningful
signaling to their customers that they're interested in not hoarding their data
leverage it back for something of value in return
